summary: The MaintServiceProfile is a web application page of HSPnet system managing service profiles. It involves rendering and handling user-control tabs such as Profile, Positions, and History, along with handling actions on these tabs.
purpose: To display and manage detailed information of service profiles, positions, and history within the HSPnet system. It allows administrators and staff to edit and view data depending on permissions.

fields.name: ServiceID
fields.description: The identifier for the service being managed.

fields.name: ReadOnly
fields.description: Flag indicating if the page is in read-only mode.

fields.name: ProfileExists
fields.description: Flag indicating if a profile exists for the service.

fields.name: PositionExists
fields.description: Flag indicating if positions exist for the service.

fields.name: SiteUsesPositions
fields.description: Flag indicating if the site uses positions.

fields.name: ServiceAgencyID
fields.description: Identifier for the service agency associated with the profile.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.role: Holds the session data for the current user, used throughout the page for various checks and operations.

workflows.name: Tab Navigation
steps: On page load, determine the current tab based on request parameters.
If the site does not use positions, disable the Positions tab.
Make the currently active tab visible and load its data.

workflows.name: Service Information Load
steps: Retrieve service information using the service ID.
Populate the profile, position, and service data on the page.
Update header information and existence flags.

business_rules: The Profile tab is shown by default if no current page is specified.
Positions tab is disabled if the site does not use positions.
Tabs are enabled based on the existence of data, indicated by flags.

validations.description: Ensures that an effective date is entered if a pay scale is selected.
Ensures that a default pay scale is selected if a secondary pay scale is chosen.

conditions.description: Screen becomes editable based on user permissions and edit mode flag.

system_behavior: Resizes the window to fit content upon pre-render.
Processes messages to display any error or warning information.
dependencies: Requires the 'UserSession' object to manage session details.
Interacts with various user controls to display and manage information.
exceptions: If the 'ServiceID' is not present, certain data cannot be loaded.
Without 'UserSession', the page cannot validate or process as intended.
